theme.emotional_tone: Premium, trustworthy, intelligent, clean, and completely un-intimidating for beginners while robust for experts.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium

typography.notes: Outfit provides a perfectly clean, geometric Apple-like structure. Manrope ensures ultimate legibility for financial data. Use JetBrains Mono for exact stock tickers and numbers to ensure tabula lining.

colors.notes: Follow the 'Tinted Grey' rule: The background shouldn't be stark #000 but rather a deep #09090B. Gains and losses must stand out immediately against these monochrome backgrounds.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use negative space to imply premium status.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid for dashboard. Tight gaps (gap-6) but immense internal padding in widgets (p-6 or p-8).
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid for the landing page. Wide gaps (gap-12), high asymmetry.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radius: Rounded corners with restrained radius. Use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl maximum. Avoid pure square edges except for very dense data tables.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) for sticky headers and bottom nav overlays. Heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl), slight saturation boost, 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/20 in light mode).

components.buttons: Flat, sharp text, slight rounded-lg. Hover state must lift (-translate-y-px) with a soft diffuse shadow. Primary buttons in light mode are black with white text; dark mode are white with black text.
components.cards: Subtle 1px border. Cardless look is preferred where possible to maintain the clean Apple-like style. When using cards, use shadow-sm with no heavy drop-shadows.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI base, customized with subtle borders. Focus state must have a crisp 2px ring of the primary brand color.
components.tables: Clean, generous row heights. Remove vertical borders. Subtly alternate row colors or use border-b only.
components.tabs: Pill-style or minimal underline. For Beginner/Advanced toggle, use a premium segment-control style (like iOS).

key_features_design_strategy.beginner_advanced_toggle: A prominent but elegant segmented control. 'Beginner' mode triggers UI changes to show plain-english tooltips, larger text explanations, and hides complex Greek indicators. 'Advanced' shows raw candlestick charts, depth, and dense data tables.
key_features_design_strategy.ai_stock_picks: Use the 'Tracing Beam' surface strategy around AI recommendation cards to make them feel active and intelligent. AI explanations should use a subtle colored background (e.g., bg-indigo-50/50 in light mode) to separate them from raw market data.
key_features_design_strategy.dual_ai_debate: Visual separation: Two side-by-side or stacked message bubbles. Use distinct but complementary subtle avatars/colors for Claude (Anthropic peach/coral hint) and Gemini (Google blue/purple hint).
key_features_design_strategy.live_ticker_bar: The 'Editorial Ribbon' Marquee strategy. Slow, smooth drift at the top of the dashboard or landing page. Monospace font for the ticker values.
key_features_design_strategy.marketing_landing_page: Hero section must use the generated 'hero_landing_background' with a max overlay of bg-white/30 or bg-black/40. High visual impact. Clean typography. Mandatory disclaimer must be styled elegantly, not hidden, but not alarming (use text_secondary color with a delicate shield icon).

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Buttons lift slightly. Data rows get a very subtle background tint change.
motion_and_interaction.chart_animations: Use recharts with activeDot expanding on hover, and smooth line stroke drawing on mount.

hero_landing_background.description: Modern minimalist Indian financial district glass building reflection. Perfect for Landing page Hero.

premium_wealth_abstract.description: Sleek marble and glass composition representing wealth and stability. Great for AI features or Portfolio sections.

stock_chart_minimal.description: Clean line chart showing data trends. Good for feature blocks on the landing page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette, using the brand neutral/monochrome combinations with green/red for stock movements.
Implement the layout with full mobile responsiveness. Use grid layout extensively.
For the Beginner/Advanced mode, ensure state management controls the conditional rendering of data density.
Build the dashboard leveraging Shadcn UI components but heavily override them to match the Apple-like clean aesthetics (e.g., removing heavy shadows, softening borders, using rounded-xl/2xl).
Ensure the Light/Dark mode toggle correctly maps all Tailwind classes.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
